Pi: `.pi/skills/<skill-name>/` in the current directory, plus `.agents/skills/<skill-name>/` from the current directory through the repo root (project installs)
Package paths listed in `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` or `.pi/settings.json`; managed packages live under `~/.pi/agent/git/`, `~/.pi/agent/npm/`, `.pi/git/`, or `.pi/npm/`
Factory Droid: `.factory/skills/<skill-name>/` from the current directory through the repo root (folder-specific or project install)
The active path shown in `/skills` under **Plugins**; installed plugins keep the shared `skills/<skill-name>/` directory inside Droid's plugin cache
